ui.learn.open: Hack: learn all actions of the equipped secondary command…
ui.learn.title: Experimental learning: preview and risks
ui.picker.secondaryHackHint: Off by default. Verified human commands only; this does not teach abilities. The command may be empty or unusable; weapon/ability conditions and game revalidation still apply. Selection only stages an edit. Reopening, switching units or disconnecting revokes authorization; select again to authorize.
ui.secondaryHackRisk.title: Confirm experimental command edit
app.name: Ivalice Trainer
ui.battle.alwaysAct.desc: After acting you return to the command menu; choose Wait to end the turn. Charging a spell doesn't end the turn either.
ui.battle.alwaysAct.title: Always act
ui.battle.alwaysMove.desc: After moving, choose Move again to keep going from where you are
ui.battle.alwaysMove.title: Always move
ui.battle.damage.title: Party damage
ui.battle.exp.desc: Party only. EXP is topped up to 99 at most; the game still handles level-ups
ui.battle.exp.title: EXP gain
ui.battle.fillCt.desc: Sets living party units' CT to 100 as a pending change; KO'd units are left alone. The unit taking its turn is affected from its next turn.
ui.battle.freezeCountdown.desc: Every 200 ms, puts the countdown of KO'd party units back to 3 when it drops below 3; other units are left alone.
ui.battle.freezeCountdown.title: Freeze KO countdown
ui.battle.guestLockHp.desc: Refills HP of living guests every 200 ms; KO'd units are left alone.
ui.battle.guestLockHp.title: Lock guest HP
ui.battle.infiniteMp.desc: Refills MP of player-controlled units every 200 ms.
ui.battle.infiniteMp.title: Infinite party MP
ui.battle.instantCast.desc: Charged abilities go off as soon as the current turn ends, before enemies can act; pair with Lock party CT to cast back to back
ui.battle.instantCast.title: Instant cast
ui.battle.jp.desc: Party only. Current and total JP cap at 9999.
ui.battle.jp.title: JP gain
ui.battle.keep.desc: No need to turn them on every fight
ui.battle.keep.title: Keep battle settings
ui.battle.keep.tooltip: When on, toggles stay on and multipliers stay set after a battle ends, and take effect again in the next battle. You can also set them up outside battle. The settings survive a trainer restart.
ui.battle.lockCt.desc: Living party units keep full CT, so enemies rarely get a turn. Per-turn statuses (Poison, Regen, etc.) are untested.
ui.battle.lockCt.title: Lock party CT
ui.battle.lockHp.desc: Refills HP of living party units every 200 ms; KO'd units are left alone.
ui.battle.lockHp.title: Lock party HP
ui.battle.maxMoveJump.desc: Party Move becomes 9 and Jump 7; only battle data changes, so it resets after battle
ui.battle.maxMoveJump.title: Max Move · Jump
ui.battle.noDeath.desc: HP never drops below 1, so the KO countdown never starts.
ui.battle.noDeath.title: No permadeath
ui.battle.sureHit.desc: Party attacks and abilities always hit.
ui.battle.sureHit.title: Sure hit
ui.battle.title: Battle
ui.bravery.braveDesc: Affects reaction ability activation and some physical damage.
ui.bravery.faithDesc: Affects magic damage dealt and received.
ui.bravery.title: Bravery & Faith
ui.equipment.title: Equipment
ui.footer.jpHint: Return to the world map in game before writing (changes written in the party menu, shops and similar screens are overwritten when you leave)
ui.items.hint: Inventory count, not counting equipped items (the in-game Owned count includes them)
ui.items.poachingNote: Carcasses come from a community table and are not yet verified in game
ui.items.searchTip: Search by item name or hex ID
ui.jobs.title: Job JP
ui.leaveRisk.body: Bravery below 10 or Faith above 94 makes a unit leave the party for good after battle. Write the following changes?
ui.leaveRisk.heading: ◆  Risk of permanent departure
ui.leaveRisk.title: Permanent departure warning
ui.picker.hint: Your choice is added to the pending changes
ui.roster.title: Units
ui.skills.hint: Only learned, eligible abilities; verified unique commands are character-specific. Unverified characters/values are read-only.
ui.skills.title: Abilities
ui.stats.derivedHint: Derived from current job and equipment
ui.stats.formulaNote: Generic unit formula; stat boosts and movement abilities are not supported yet
ui.stats.growthHint: Levels up one at a time with the current job's growth; EXP is kept
ui.stats.title: Base Stats
ui.waiting.desc: Looks for the game process every 2 seconds
ui.waiting.title: Waiting for FFT_enhanced.exe…
